evidence: A formal ridenpc.lua exists in both data and hydata with identical blob SHA 5378cbb6f2bdbd0cb8777ba0c7a71b579e4683f7.
ridenpc2.lua~ is a distinct blob and not a same-file mirror; it defines its own main() that creates a ride-certificate NPC.

The residue and formal sibling have materially different NPC instantiation and reward tables: residue creates at 2005,(28,12) with metamo 41155 and offers 23805/23820/29061/29117; formal sibling creates at 2005,(28,11) with metamo 24774 and offers 23825/23830/23815/23810/29061/29117.
No repository-side exact binding to ridenpc2.lua~ or a loader entry selecting it was found.
Endpoint setup.cf points the default NPC configuration root at data/npc; the residue is under hydata/data/ablua, so its execution also depends on the separate ABLUA/endpoint loader path.

Public ABLua documentation describes main() as the startup entry and npc.CreateNpc/char.setFunctionPointer as the NPC binding pattern, which corroborates the script's execution model but does not prove this residue was selected by the ro0000 build.

notes.publicAbluaCorroboration: main() is used as the startup entry; CreateNpc plus setFunctionPointer is the documented NPC creation/binding pattern
